label: Frame the comparison
artifact: Status, coverage and timing as separate signals
title: A smaller failure total can hide a missing test.
detail: Compare exact test identities across two reports. Show removed and newly skipped coverage beside regressions and recoveries, so fewer failures alone cannot imply acceptance.

label: Define exact identities
title: Make a match unambiguous.
detail: A test is identified by its case-sensitive suite/name pair, with whitespace preserved. Validate statuses and finite durations, reject duplicate identities, and sort deterministically.

label: Share the comparison core
artifact: One pure core for browser and CLI
title: Explain every identity on both sides.
detail: The same engine classifies the union of baseline and candidate cases. The bundled example has seven tests on each side but eight distinct identities, including one removal and one addition.

label: Make acceptance explicit
title: Keep the decision separate from timing advice.
detail: Any candidate failure blocks acceptance. Unpermitted coverage gaps or an empty candidate remain incomplete. Timing warnings require two strict thresholds and never alter the verdict.

label: Challenge stale results
title: An older read must not restore an obsolete verdict.
detail: Replacement clears the result immediately. Each input has its own generation token, so late reads are ignored while the untouched report can still finish loading.

label: Package reproducibility
artifact: Standalone demo, source and complete sample artifact
title: Make a failed comparison reproducible too.
detail: The saved sample intentionally exits with code 1. Keep its reasons, policy and all rows with the source and verification, rather than presenting only favourable results.
